record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.context_brief: Borel embeddings into ergodic toral automorphisms
record.original_question: Let (T^d, R) be a toral automorphism that is ergodic for Lebesgue measure, and let (Y, S) be a homeomorphism of a Polish space with no invariant probability measure. Does there exist an equivariant Borel embedding of (Y, S) into (T^d, R)?

evidence.quote: Question 5.6. [10] Let (Td, R) be a toral automorphism which is ergodic for the Lebesgue measure. Let (Y, S) be a homeomorphism of a Polish space without any invariant probability measure. Is there an equivariant Borel embedding of (Y, S) into (Td, R)?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let d ≥ 2 and let R: T^d → T^d be an automorphism of the d-dimensional torus T^d = R^d/Z^d (i.e., R is induced by a matrix in GL_d(Z)) that is ergodic with respect to Lebesgue measure on T^d. Let Y be a Polish space and let S: Y → Y be a homeomorphism such that the dynamical system (Y, S) admits no S-invariant Borel probability measure. An equivariant Borel embedding of (Y, S) into (T^d, R) is an injective Borel measurable map f: Y → T^d such that f ∘ S = R ∘ f. Does such an equivariant Borel embedding always exist?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search reveals related work on Borel embeddings of systems into subshifts and on Borel automorphisms without invariant measures (e.g., generator theorems by Hochman and work on Borel factors/embeddings into subshifts), but no source directly resolves the specific question of equivariant Borel embedding of any invariant-measure-free Polish homeomorphism into an ergodic toral automorphism. The status appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Borel factors and embeddings of systems in subshifts
status_evidence.snippet: Studies equivariant Borel embeddings of dynamical systems into subshifts.
status_evidence.claim: Related embedding results exist for subshifts, but not specifically for ergodic toral automorphisms as targets.

status_evidence.title: Every Borel automorphism without finite invariant measures admits a two-set generator
status_evidence.snippet: Generator theorem for Borel automorphisms without invariant probability measures.
status_evidence.claim: This gives Borel embeddings into the full 2-shift but does not address ergodic toral automorphism targets.
